Subject: MAP adjustment + compressed eval runway — proposal and ask

Hi Lori,

Thanks again for the candid sync this morning. Per our conversation I put together a compact proposal to keep your go-live window intact while acknowledging the integration team's request to compress the evaluation timeline. The attached MAP_BlueHealth_v2_20270222.pdf shows the updated gating and acceptance windows; key highlights below:

- Shift acceptance start from 2027-04-12 to 2027-04-05 (one-week pull-in) with a parallelized eval stream (two smaller cohorts rather than one big end-to-end).
- Reduce full regression sign-off to 5 critical prompts initially (evaluation_matrix_BH.xlsx attached) and follow with a 2-week quality ramp that runs in parallel to the pilot.
- Contingency: if we see >3 failing prompts in cohort A by day 5, automatic fallback to the benign-variant model and a pre-negotiated 10% credit for April consumption.

As asks to make this realistic:
1) Can procurement confirm a 2-week contract amendment window (Ben in cc)? We'd log the temporary pilot terms in HubSpot.
2) Can you confirm which stakeholders will review the 5 critical prompts (clinical lead + ops)?
3) I need a firm date by EOD Friday so we can allocate a small dedicated pool for the compressed eval (this affects our resource schedule).

I'm looping Marissa and Grace on scope/resource — Marissa will propose the runbook and Grace will validate the regression-sample selection.

Attaching: MAP_BlueHealth_v2_20270222.pdf, evaluation_matrix_BH.xlsx

Best,

Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Alex / Marissa / Lori (cc) —

Quoted prompt set below — five targeted prompts selected to exercise hallucination, instruction-following, and information extraction across realistic BlueHealth scenarios. I'll included pass/fail criteria inline.

1) Patient intake triage question: expected slot extraction accuracy >= 95%.
2) Medication reconciliation: no hallucinated drug interactions; precision >= 98%.
3) Clinical note summarization: ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on sampled set.
4) Eligibility check (complex logic): decision parity with clinical rule engine >= 99%.
5) Privacy redaction: no PHI bleed on 500-sample sweep.

If cohort A passes on day 5 under those metrics we lift pilot locks and proceed to the broader pilot. If not, per the MAP the baseline variant remains in front of traffic and we trigger the contingency credit.

Procurement / Ben — can we confirm the 2-week amendment window? If procurement signs off we'll keep the compressed runway and allocate a dedicated GPU pool starting 2027-03-15.

Lori — I'll drop the one-page SOC2 summary and audit-log extract to your procurement address right after this thread.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Product Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
